name: hawary-workflow-skills
description: Public-safe workflow skills for coding agents that need source-backed planning, review, QA, audits, and dependency checks.

skills.name: cross-layer-contract-audit
skills.description: Audit client, API, database, and docs for contract mismatches. Use for schema drift, auth/session/payment changes, migrations, or integration regressions.

skills.name: dependency-security-auditor
skills.description: Audit dependency CVEs across Node, Python, Flutter/Dart, and mixed repos; design OSV/native audit hooks for pre-push and CI.

skills.name: dev-secrets
skills.description: Use when asked to handle .env files, local secrets, vault workflows, or risks exposing real values to an AI agent. Outputs: safe evidence, warnings, next command, recovery.

skills.name: feature-spec-delivery-pipeline
skills.description: Turn a feature request or bug cluster into a source-backed spec, impact map, acceptance criteria, and delivery plan before coding.

skills.name: mobile-maestro-e2e-orchestrator
skills.description: Run evidence-driven mobile E2E tests with Maestro, device logs, checkpoints, and targeted retries for iOS or Android flows.

skills.name: project-docs-cleanup
skills.description: Audit project docs for stale, duplicate, contradictory, or missing workflow artifacts before cleanup or handoff.

skills.name: project-status-dashboard
skills.description: Build a read-only project health dashboard from git state, docs, CI hints, open work, branch drift, and likely next steps.

skills.name: pull-request-review-loop
skills.description: Review pull requests with adversarial findings, fix validation, re-review loops, local artifacts, and source-backed proof before merge.

skills.name: qa-bug-hunt-planner
skills.description: Run source-backed QA discovery, recommend audit tracks, build fix-ready bug-hunt plans, and define verification gates.

skills.name: repo-workflow-checker
skills.description: Check whether a repo has an agent workflow scaffold: instructions, work queues, specs, skills, verification commands, and archive conventions.
